candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement assigning totalDistributed to the owner's balance in XBornID, so balances[owner] stays 0.
Delete the balance credit to the recipient in distr, so tokens distributed via getTokens never appear in the recipient's balance.
Replace the incremental balance credit with a direct assignment, so repeated distributions overwrite instead of accumulate.
Remove the statement that decrements the allowance, so transferFrom no longer reduces allowed[_from][msg.sender].
Change the allowance update from subtraction to addition, so the allowance increases instead of decreasing after transferFrom.
Set the allowance to _amount instead of subtracting _amount, changing the resulting allowance value.
Change the assertion from >= to <= so transferFrom always reverts, meaning allowed is never updated for any caller.
